74cb8653a1971d3707c6bfd8614db10c3e5711f6.summary: Blog post by Michael T. Raggo of MobileIron on XARA, a set of vulnerabilities that Indiana University researchers announced for OS X and iOS. It explains iOS URL scheme hijacking: Apple does not enforce unique URL scheme names, so a malicious app can use another app's scheme and be used in phishing. The post says FireEye outlined similar attacks in February 2015 as Masque Attack II. It lists iOS hygiene steps and the company's AppConnect technology as protection.
